drowsiness.title: Alpha over Theta with a sleep guardrail
drowsiness.subtitle: An Alpha-over-Theta rest reward, plus an on-device AI layer (LUNA/REVE) that watches a rolling 4–5 second window of raw EEG each second for the signatures of actually falling asleep, and plays a soft warning chime when you drift — so the rest stays awake. The guardrail is an option: switch it off to run the plain rest engine.
drowsiness.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Gentle, non-striving attention with the eyes closed.

Ultimate Goal
To rest at the edge of sleep and remain aware. The AI guardrail is a tripwire, not a driver: when the live EEG looks like sleep — not just drowsiness — a soft chime invites you back. It never rewards or punishes; it informs.

Mind & State Effects
The reward drives calm-awake training; the guardrail tries to catch the moment of falling asleep and sounds a gentle wake note so the session stays a rest, not a nap.

Scientific Explanation
- Reward: the ATR rest metric — alpha ÷ theta on the AF7/AF8 average. The guardrail never changes the reward.
- Guardrail: the on-device model (LUNA or REVE, RLX CPU engine) embeds a rolling window of raw EEG at 256 Hz, once per second (LUNA epochs are 5 s / 1280 samples; REVE 4 s / 1024 samples). During calibration it records an eyes-open "clear" anchor and an eyes-closed rest distribution. During the session a warning fires when the live sleep-direction measure is above the session warning threshold (default: 75th percentile of your eyes-closed rest baseline) or the frontal delta is above a ceiling. The model is a statistical estimate, not a medical device — false alarms are possible.

Target Meditation Styles
Yoga Nidra, deep rest practice, sleep-adjacent meditations where staying aware matters.

Who It Helps
- Practitioners who want the restoring depth of near-sleep rest while keeping a thread of awareness.
- People who reliably doze off in meditation and want a gentle tripwire.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone who needs guaranteed wakefulness: the guardrail is an approximate cue, not a safety device.
drowsiness.algorithmDescription: ATR reward (alpha ÷ theta) plus the LUNA/REVE AI sleep guardrail: a per-second model score over a rolling EEG window (LUNA 5 s / 1280 samples, REVE 4 s / 1024 samples). During calibration it captures an eyes-open "V_clear" anchor and a rest (eyes-closed) sleep-direction distribution. During training a warning chime fires when the live sleep direction exceeds the Warning Threshold (default 75th percentile of your rest baseline) or the frontal delta exceeds the ceiling. Guardrail only — the ATR reward is never affected.
drowsiness.metadataDescription: Trains the calm-awake rest state. The reward is the Alpha-over-Theta ratio (ATR = alpha ÷ theta) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), scored once per second and rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution; the threshold adapts during the session (dynamic adapt) to remain in the learning zone. The AI sleep guardrail (LUNA or REVE, RLX CPU engine) embeds a rolling window of raw EEG once per second (LUNA 5 s / 1280 samples, REVE 4 s / 1024 samples) and warns when the live sleep-direction score exceeds the session warning threshold (default 75th percentile of the eyes-closed rest baseline) or the frontal delta exceeds a ceiling. The guardrail only warns — it never modulates the reward.

twilight.title: Theta over Alpha (TAR, hypnagogic rest)
twilight.subtitle: Rewards rising Theta relative to Alpha on the frontal electrodes — training the twilight state between waking calm and sleep, the zone used for hypnagogic imagery and WILD-style lucid dreaming entry. The AI sleep guardrail keeps you from crossing into actual sleep.
twilight.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Lie down or sit comfortably, close your eyes, and let the mind sink toward the threshold of sleep — heavy, dreamy, drifting. Keep just enough awareness to stay present; the reward encourages the theta-dominant borderland, not unconsciousness.

Ultimate Goal
A mind-awake, body-asleep state: deep hypnagogic relaxation where imagery and dreamlike thought arise while a thread of awareness stays online. This is the entry zone for WILD-style lucid dreaming and deeply restorative rest.

Mind & State Effects
Theta dominance is associated with drowsiness, hypnagogic imagery and the transition into sleep. Training it deliberately builds familiarity with the borderland — the reward rises as Theta overtakes Alpha on the frontal electrodes, while the guardrail warns when the signal moves toward actual sleep.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Bands: Theta (4–8 Hz) and Alpha (8–13 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8).
- The Mechanism: as relaxation deepens toward sleep, Theta power grows relative to Alpha. The ratio trains that direction.
- The Reward Criterion: the Theta/Alpha ratio (TAR = theta ÷ alpha) is rewarded while it stays above your personal baseline percentile. In plain terms the training encourages the twilight state, not sleep.
- Guardrail: the on-device AI layer (LUNA/REVE) and the frontal-delta ceiling warn when the state crosses into actual sleep — statistical estimates, not a medical device.

Target Meditation Styles
Hypnagogic exploration, Yoga Nidra, WILD-style lucid dreaming preparation, deep rest.

Who It Helps
- Practitioners working with lucid dreaming entry and hypnagogic imagery.
- People who want the deep rest of the sleep border while keeping awareness.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone who needs guaranteed wakefulness: the guardrail is an approximate cue, not a safety device.
- Those who find the hypnagogic state disorienting or who simply want to stay asleep — use a rest protocol without the sleep edge.
twilight.algorithmDescription: Computes the Theta/Alpha ratio (TAR = theta power ÷ alpha power) on the AF7/AF8 average. The reward fires while TAR is above a threshold derived from your personal baseline: a configurable percentile of the calibration distribution. The threshold adapts during the session to keep you in the learning zone. The LUNA/REVE AI sleep guardrail warns (chime, plus music muffle) when the live sleep direction or frontal delta crosses into actual sleep.
twilight.metadataDescription: Trains the hypnagogic twilight state at the border of sleep. The reward is the Theta-over-Alpha ratio (TAR = theta ÷ alpha) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), scored once per second and rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution; the threshold adapts during the session. The AI sleep guardrail warns when the live sleep-direction score crosses the warning threshold or the frontal delta exceeds a ceiling, keeping the practice at the sleep border rather than in sleep.

alertnessOpen.title: Beta over Theta (BTR, eyes open)
alertnessOpen.subtitle: Trains higher Beta relative to Theta with the eyes open — the classic alertness-and-attention ratio. Calibrates with an eyes-open baseline so the target matches how you actually practice.
alertnessOpen.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Keep your eyes open. Settle into a soft, non-strained gaze and bring a gentle but continuous attention to the present — sensations, breath, or the room around you. This is an active, engaged state, not a sleepy one.

Ultimate Goal
A wakeful, alert state with the eyes open: higher relative Beta (engaged attention) and lower relative Theta (drowsiness, under-arousal). The reward rises as the ratio tips toward alertness.

Mind & State Effects
Beta-band activity is linked to active attention, thinking and focused engagement. Training the Beta/Theta ratio leans the state toward readiness and away from drowsiness — useful for seated attention practice and daytime alertness.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Bands: Beta (13–30 Hz) and Theta (4–8 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8).
- The Mechanism: with eyes open, relative Beta reflects engaged attention while Theta tracks drowsiness and under-arousal.
- The Reward Criterion: the Beta/Theta ratio (BTR = beta ÷ theta) is rewarded while it stays above your personal baseline percentile. Eyes-open signal is noisier (blinks, muscle) — the movement gate drops contaminated samples.

Target Meditation Styles
Open-eyed attention, walking meditation, active mindfulness.

Who It Helps
- People who practice eyes-open meditation.
- Anyone wanting to train alertness and reduce drowsy drift during sitting practice.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone seeking deep rest — this protocol rewards the opposite direction.
alertnessOpen.algorithmDescription: Computes the Beta/Theta ratio (β ÷ θ) on the AF7/AF8 average. The reward fires while the ratio stays above a personal baseline percentile — training higher relative beta (alert, engaged) versus theta (drowsy, under-aroused). Calibrated eyes-open with a movement/artifact gate.
alertnessOpen.metadataDescription: Trains alertness with the eyes open. The reward is the Beta-over-Theta ratio (BTR = beta ÷ theta) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), scored once per second and rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-open calibration distribution. Movement- and artifact-contaminated samples are gated out. No sleep guardrail runs for this protocol (eyes-open practice has no sleep drift to guard against).

alertnessClosed.title: Beta over Theta (BTR, eyes closed)
alertnessClosed.subtitle: The same Beta-over-Theta alertness reward with an eyes-closed calibration — a still, seated attention state without the visual input.
alertnessClosed.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Close your eyes and hold a steady, wakeful attention — on the breath, on body sensations, on the space around you. Stay engaged: this is alertness training, not rest.

Ultimate Goal
A wakeful eyes-closed state: higher relative Beta (engaged attention) and lower relative Theta (drowsiness). The reward rises as the ratio tips toward alertness.

Mind & State Effects
Same ratio as the eyes-open variant, minus visual input: a still, focused attention that resists drowsy drift — useful for long seated practice where the mind tends to sag.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Bands: Beta (13–30 Hz) and Theta (4–8 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8).
- The Mechanism: eyes-closed Theta rises with drowsiness; keeping relative Beta high tracks sustained engagement.
- The Reward Criterion: the Beta/Theta ratio (BTR = beta ÷ theta) is rewarded while it stays above your personal baseline percentile. The movement gate drops contaminated samples.

Target Meditation Styles
Seated attention, breath awareness, concentration practice with eyes closed.

Who It Helps
- Practitioners who train alertness with eyes closed.
- Anyone who dozes off in eyes-closed sitting and wants a alertness-oriented target.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone seeking deep rest — this protocol rewards the opposite direction.
alertnessClosed.algorithmDescription: Computes the Beta/Theta ratio (β ÷ θ) on the AF7/AF8 average. The reward fires while the ratio stays above a personal baseline percentile — training higher relative beta (alert, engaged) versus theta (drowsy, under-aroused). Calibrated eyes-closed with a movement/artifact gate.
alertnessClosed.metadataDescription: Trains alertness with the eyes closed. The reward is the Beta-over-Theta ratio (BTR = beta ÷ theta) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), scored once per second and rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution. Movement- and artifact-contaminated samples are gated out.

mindfulness.title: Alpha Uptraining (open monitoring)
mindfulness.subtitle: Rewards rising relative Alpha on the frontal electrodes — the calm, wakeful rhythm of open monitoring meditation. Simpler and gentler than the ratio protocols: just more Alpha, no ratio juggling.
mindfulness.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Close your eyes and rest in open awareness: notice whatever arises — thoughts, sounds, sensations — without following or resisting. No effort, no control; just present attention.

Ultimate Goal
A stable, calm, aware state with elevated relative Alpha — the rhythm classically associated with relaxed wakefulness and open monitoring practice.

Mind & State Effects
Raising relative Alpha leans the nervous system toward calm, settled attention: less agitation, less drowsiness, a quiet observing mind.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Band: Alpha (8–13 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), as a fraction of total power.
- The Mechanism: closing the eyes typically raises Alpha; open-monitoring practice is associated with sustained Alpha presence.
- The Reward Criterion: relative Alpha is rewarded while it stays above your personal baseline percentile — no ratio, so the target is simply "more of the calm rhythm".

Target Meditation Styles
Open Monitoring, Mindfulness, Vipassana, passive awareness.

Who It Helps
- Beginners wanting a simple, forgiving target.
- Practitioners of open-monitoring meditation.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone whose goal is alertness or engagement — this rewards calm, not activation.
- Habitual meditation sleepers may drift: Alpha is a resting rhythm; there is no sleep guardrail here.
mindfulness.algorithmDescription: Rewards relative Alpha power (alpha ÷ total band power) on the AF7/AF8 average. The reward fires while relative Alpha is above a threshold derived from your personal baseline: a configurable percentile of the calibration distribution. The threshold adapts during the session to keep you in the learning zone.
mindfulness.metadataDescription: Trains calm, wakeful open-monitoring attention. The reward is the relative Alpha power (alpha ÷ total band power) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), scored once per second and rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution; the threshold adapts during the session. A single-band target — no ratio.

concentration.title: Stable Alpha + Beta Inhibit
concentration.subtitle: Rewards sustained relative Alpha while relative Beta stays low — a calm, stable attention with the busy high-frequency chatter dampened. Patterns associated with sustained attention in contemplative EEG work.
concentration.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Close your eyes and place your attention on a single object — the breath, a mantra, a point of sensation. When the mind wanders, gently return. The reward wants both: calm Alpha presence and low Beta busyness.

Ultimate Goal
A stable, focused state: elevated relative Alpha (calm presence) together with low relative Beta (quieted discursive thought). The reward fires only when both hold at once.

Mind & State Effects
Sustained attention practice: the calm rhythm stays up while the high-frequency "thinking" markers stay down — a quiet, stable focus.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Bands: Alpha (8–13 Hz) and Beta (13–30 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8).
- The Mechanism: sustained attention is associated with stable Alpha; elevated Beta tracks active, often discursive thinking.
- The Reward Criterion: relative Alpha is rewarded while it stays above your personal baseline percentile AND relative Beta stays at or below a fixed ceiling. Claims are limited to patterns associated with sustained attention — this is not a measurement of concentration itself.

Target Meditation Styles
Focused Attention, Samatha, breath meditation, mantra.

Who It Helps
- Practitioners of focused-attention meditation.
- People wanting a "quiet mind" training target.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone seeking activation or alertness training.
- Those who find goal-directed concentration effortful or counterproductive.
concentration.algorithmDescription: Rewards relative Alpha (alpha ÷ total power) on the AF7/AF8 average while relative Beta stays ≤ 0.25 (the beta-inhibit leg). Alpha must beat the baseline percentile threshold AND the beta ceiling must hold — both conditions gate the reward. The Alpha threshold adapts during the session.
concentration.metadataDescription: Trains stable, focused attention. The reward is the relative Alpha power (alpha ÷ total band power) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8) rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution AND relative Beta stays ≤ 0.25 (beta-inhibit — quieted high-frequency activity). Both conditions gate the reward; the Alpha threshold adapts during the session.

relaxedConcentration.title: Alpha over Theta + Rest Guard (access concentration)
relaxedConcentration.subtitle: A calm Alpha-over-Theta reward with extra guards: low Beta (quiet mind) and low Delta (no sleep), plus the AI sleep guardrail. A practical proxy used by practitioners approaching absorption — sustained calm frontal alpha with reduced high-frequency activity.
relaxedConcentration.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Settle into deep stillness: eyes closed, body motionless, attention softly absorbed in the present. Let the mind quiet completely — not sleepy, not busy, just still and absorbed.

Ultimate Goal
A deeply still, absorbed state: strong calm Alpha, minimal busy Beta, minimal slow-wave drift toward sleep. The rewards stack — Alpha/Theta high, Beta low, Delta low, body still.

Mind & State Effects
Deep calm with reduced mental chatter: the state practitioners describe approaching absorption. Science on true jhana EEG is sparse and mixed; this protocol stays descriptive — it trains a practical proxy, not a diagnosis.

Scientific Explanation
- Target Bands: Alpha (8–13 Hz), Theta (4–8 Hz), Beta (13–30 Hz) and Delta (1–4 Hz) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8).
- The Mechanism: absorption practices are described as sustained calm alpha with reduced high-frequency activity; sleep is characterized by rising delta.
- The Reward Criterion: the Alpha/Theta ratio (ATR) must beat the baseline percentile AND relative Beta ≤ 0.25 AND relative Delta ≤ 0.5. The AI guardrail additionally warns on sleep-direction drift — the delta condition and guardrail keep the stillness out of sleep.

Target Meditation Styles
Access concentration, absorption practice, deep Samatha.

Who It Helps
- Practitioners working toward absorption states.
- People with a strong, established attention who want deeper stillness.

Who Should Avoid This
- Beginners: the stacked conditions make the target harder to reach — start with Sleep-Edge Rest.
- Anyone who needs guaranteed wakefulness: the guardrail is an approximate cue, not a safety device.
relaxedConcentration.algorithmDescription: Rewards the Alpha/Theta ratio (ATR = alpha ÷ theta) on the AF7/AF8 average while relative Beta ≤ 0.25 and relative Delta ≤ 0.5 — a calm, quiet, non-sleeping state. ATR must beat the baseline percentile threshold AND both conditions must hold; the LUNA/REVE AI sleep guardrail warns (chime, plus music muffle) on sleep drift. The ATR threshold adapts during the session.
relaxedConcentration.metadataDescription: Trains deep stillness as a proxy for access concentration. The reward is the Alpha-over-Theta ratio (ATR = alpha ÷ theta) on the frontal electrodes (AF7/AF8), rewarded while it stays above a personal baseline percentile of the eyes-closed calibration distribution AND relative Beta ≤ 0.25 AND relative Delta ≤ 0.5 — a calm, quiet, non-sleeping state. The AI sleep guardrail additionally warns on sleep-direction drift. The ATR threshold adapts during the session.

recordOnly.title: Pure EEG Recording
recordOnly.subtitle: Records the session without any reward engine, guardrail, or feedback sounds — a quiet, clean recording of your raw EEG and signals. Calibration is optional: start with the usual baseline, or skip it and just record.
recordOnly.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Anything you like — this protocol only records. Meditate, rest, work, or simply sit; the raw EEG, bands, and signals are saved for later review.

Ultimate Goal
A clean, self-contained recording with no feedback shaping your state. Use it to capture practice for review or to collect data without any training signal.

Mind & State Effects
None by design: no reward chimes, no music filter, no guardrail warnings. What you do with the time is entirely up to you.

Scientific Explanation
- No reward metric runs; no threshold is derived.
- Calibration (when kept) only establishes a baseline in the metadata — it does not gate any feedback.
- The session still records every enabled stream and produces a full history entry with summary charts.

Target Meditation Styles
Unstructured practice, data collection, recording sessions you want to review later.

Who It Helps
- Anyone who wants the raw data without a training target.
- Testers and reviewers comparing recordings across sessions.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone wanting live feedback or guidance — pick a training protocol instead.
recordOnly.algorithmDescription: Recording only: every enabled stream (EEG, bands, PPG, pulse, IMU, movement, peak alpha, telemetry) is written to the session file. No reward metric, no ATR baseline evaluation, no guardrail layer, no feedback sounds. An optional calibration baseline is recorded in the metadata when the normal start is used.
recordOnly.metadataDescription: Recording only: no reward metric, no guardrail, no feedback sounds. Every enabled stream (EEG, bands, PPG, pulse, IMU, movement, peak alpha, telemetry) is written to the session file. When calibration is not skipped, an eyes-closed baseline is captured and recorded in the metadata — it does not gate any feedback.

guardrailOnly.title: AI Sleep Guardrail Only
guardrailOnly.subtitle: No reward engine — just the on-device AI sleep guardrail. A 3-stage calibration captures your clear and rest baselines, then the LUNA/REVE layer watches for the signature of actually falling asleep and warns you back. Rest without any training signal.
guardrailOnly.guideText:
What to Meditate On
Rest, with the eyes closed. Drift toward sleep as far as you like — the guardrail will gently bring you back when the signal looks like you have actually fallen asleep.

Ultimate Goal
Deep, safe rest at the edge of sleep with no reward pressure: the guardrail is the only voice in the session, and it only warns.

Mind & State Effects
Rest and near-sleep exploration without any ratio training. The warning chime invites awareness back when sleep signs appear.

Scientific Explanation
- No reward metric runs — the session is scored only by the guardrail layer.
- The 3-stage calibration records artifacts, an eyes-open clear anchor, and an eyes-closed rest distribution; the warning threshold derives from your own baseline.
- During the session the on-device model (LUNA/REVE, RLX CPU) embeds a rolling EEG window each second; a warning fires when the sleep direction passes the threshold or frontal delta exceeds the ceiling. A statistical estimate, not a medical device.

Target Meditation Styles
Deep rest, Yoga Nidra, sleep-adjacent practice where only the tripwire matters.

Who It Helps
- People who doze off in rest practice and want a gentle wake note without any reward shaping.

Who Should Avoid This
- Anyone who needs guaranteed wakefulness: the guardrail is an approximate cue, not a safety device.
guardrailOnly.algorithmDescription: Guardrail only: the 3-stage calibration (artifacts, eyes-open clear anchor, eyes-closed rest distribution) feeds the LUNA/REVE on-device scorer or the band-math fallback; the ATR reward engine and feedback sounds are disabled. A warning chime fires when the live sleep direction exceeds the warning threshold (default 75th percentile of the rest baseline) or frontal delta exceeds the ceiling.
guardrailOnly.metadataDescription: Guardrail-only rest practice: no reward engine runs — the session is scored only by the sleep guardrail. The 3-stage calibration (artifact blinks/clenches, an eyes-open clear anchor, an eyes-closed rest distribution) feeds the on-device AI scorer (LUNA/REVE, RLX CPU) or, when no model is installed, the band-math fallback on frontal delta. A warning fires when the live sleep direction exceeds the warning threshold (default 75th percentile of the eyes-closed rest baseline) or frontal delta exceeds a ceiling.
